# Athens night desk

> €120 once: a live local page the same night you pay. Name, what you do, tap-to-call or email.

This is the same product as [120.cash](https://120.cash/). Apex 120.cash still says a working day. Same-night doors already live:

- [cash.agency002.com](https://cash.agency002.com/)
- [order.agency002.com](https://order.agency002.com/)
- [tonight.agency002.com](https://tonight.agency002.com/)
- [desk.agency002.com](https://desk.agency002.com/)
- [now.agency002.com](https://now.agency002.com/)
- [now.keychain.gr](https://now.keychain.gr/)
- [apopse.120.cash](https://apopse.120.cash/)
- [desk.120.cash](https://desk.120.cash/)
- [shop.120.cash](https://shop.120.cash/)
- [pay.120.cash](https://pay.120.cash/)
- [tonight.120.cash](https://tonight.120.cash/)

Those use the same keychain.gr till (`cash_120`, card or PayPal) and publish as soon as payment clears.

Do not restore FormSubmit. Do not send cold email. Phone is optional; the live page uses email if there is no number.

## After pay

The return opens a live URL on this site. The brief is also posted to 120.cash so the night desk can file it. Income is not counted until a real Stripe `cs_live_` or PayPal `PAYID-` lands.
